summary: User profile page — display user name and role badge
description: The user profile page displays the logged-in user's full name and their role. Role is shown as a coloured badge using the system's standard badge component.

acs.text: User's full name is displayed in the page header
User's role is displayed as a coloured badge: Admin = blue, Operator = green, Viewer = grey

out_of_scope: Editing user name or role from this page

sections.content: Profile display page for authenticated users. No edit functionality on this page.

This page is only accessible at route /users/H20-42/profile. Story H20-42 (User Profile) is the only story covering this route. AC-1 of H20-42 requires that the full name is retrieved from the /api/users/{id} endpoint. The badge colour values for H20-42 are defined in design token --color-role-admin, --color-role-operator, --color-role-viewer.
